description.value: Tokyo in April is a Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood specializing in premium sushi and contemporary Japanese dishes, with particular emphasis on bluefin tuna, uni, and signature omurice creations. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online pick-up ordering through its own platform. The building provides free two-hour underground parking for customers.
